_comment: The SHAPE v6 — the ALBUM CUT, drop-as-outro. Trimmed front (comedy timing untouched), then the drop IS the rest of the song: two punching rows with techsub back from the shelf for weight, then an 8-bar fading exhale of the same kit with the cadenza drone surfacing beneath it — E E A A E E A A, ending on A as the fader reaches zero, merging straight into essay-1. No clearing, no separate cadence.
